trust_decision.summary: The fix decides that two disk-borne inputs are untrusted and moves the decision to the read sink: the module-preload cache is never handed to a general unpickler (all class lookups refused), and the output of an external 7z/tar extraction is measured and deleted when it exceeds 1 GB; the archive *contents* check is not touched because it already exists at the pinned commit.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names Zip-Slip in the unarchive module, and extract_file at :69-91 is the only place that shells out to 7z/tar (command built at :82, run at :84), so an engineer reading only the summary starts there.

fix_sites.entry_point: every scan/`bbot -l` startup that builds a Preset -> ModuleLoader.preload() -> preload_cache getter (script entry `bbot` = bbot.cli:main)
same ModuleLoader.preload_cache property; the general pickle.load is replaced by _SafeUnpickler(...).load() (fix.diff:27)
unarchive internal module on FILESYSTEM events (bbot/modules/internal/unarchive.py:48)
unarchive internal module, after the 7z/tar subprocess completes (bbot/modules/internal/unarchive.py:84)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The ffuf_shortnames CustomUnpickler exists only to remap MinimalWordPredictor (it delegates every other class to super().find_class) and it loads word-prediction models from the bbot org's own GitHub over HTTPS, so a solver can call it a trusted model loader rather than the preload cache the report names.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The preload cache must keep round-tripping its builtin-only dicts through save_preload_cache/atexit (the file is opened and unpickled directly by the tests, so switching the on-disk format breaks them; a blanket 'never load the cache' also silently kills module cache hits at bbot/core/modules.py:149 inside a suppress(Exception)); and nested archive-in-archive extraction must keep recursing through extract_file, so a cap placed before/around the 7z call rather than after it breaks the nested-zip case.

O6_input_shapes: preload cache pickle carrying a malicious class reference (__reduce__/GLOBAL) vs. the benign dict-of-builtins cache
archive formats handled by different tools: zip and 7z (7z listing) vs tar/gzip/bzip2/xz (tar listing)
small archive that inflates past the cap: one huge member, many small members, or an archive nested inside an archive (recursion at unarchive.py:85-87), each checked per output_dir

O7_producer.where: bbot/core/modules.py:224-232 (preload_cache setter -> pickle.dump, driven by save_preload_cache at :231-232 and atexit at :73)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ZMQ RPC client deserializes every received frame with pickle.loads (EngineBase.unpickle, plus direct pickle.loads on cancel/shutdown replies)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The engine is an internal ipc:// socket in tempfile.gettempdir() between bbot's own parent/child processes (engine.py:134, :322, :399), so the peer is our own code, not the cache an attacker can plant.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 1 package (bbot/core) up from the unarchive landing point; same package as the fixed pickle site

O8_uncovered_routes.route: helper-level wordlist zip unpack writes an archive member to the cache dir with no size cap, the same 'unbounded archive extraction' sink the unarchive hunk closes
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It extracts exactly the single member name the calling module asked for, from a wordlist the project could not have foreseen being a bomb, and Python's zipfile already sanitizes paths so the traversal half does not apply.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 1 package (bbot/core/helpers) from the landing point, in a helper rather than a module

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third pickled model file loaded through the same permissive CustomUnpickler
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The module already loads two .bin models this way; adding another predictor or a subword model is a one-line copy of the existing pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a size/unpack guard on wordlist zip extraction in the helper layer
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the helper-layer twin of the unarchive path, reached by many modules, and a maintainer hardening archive handling would naturally write the same cap here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a per-document cap on text extracted from untrusted files
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same 'untrusted file is parsed/expanded on our behalf' mechanism as unarchive, and the loop at :115-118 accumulates without bound, so the same guard is realistic.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another pickled state file under cache_dir (install-status cache) read at startup
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already uses parent_helper.cache_dir, the same directory as module_preload_cache, and a maintainer caching install results would reuse the pickle-file idiom.

O9_family: insecure deserialization of a persisted cache (CWE-502) bundled with unbounded archive extraction / decompression bomb (CWE-409); the advisory itself labels it path traversal (CWE-22, CWE-61). The DoS-flavoured size cap is weak task material on its own.

O10_build.toolchain: Poetry (pyproject.toml:1-26, build backend poetry-dynamic-versioning at :115-117); pytest with pytest-env/pytest-asyncio configured at pyproject.toml:98-104
services: external `7z` binary (unarchive zip/7z listing and extraction)
ZeroMQ ipc:// socket between bbot's own processes for scans
O10_build.project_tests: bbot/test/test_step_2/module_tests/test_module_unarchive.py:12 (TestUnarchive: all seven formats plus zip-in-zip) and :244 (TestUnarchiveTraversalCheck, driven through _check_archive_safe); preload-cache save/load round trip at bbot/test/test_step_1/test_presets.py:631-667

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Put a class allowlist on the default preload-cache file only and add the size check only in handle_event for zip archives, leaving the recursive extract_file path, the other formats and the ffuf_shortnames unpickler untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: Nothing outside this advisory's protection was pursued; the pre-existing traversal/symlink guard at bbot/modules/internal/unarchive.py:93-123 is untouched by the fix and was not probed for bypasses.
unverified: The recorded fix diff contains no change to bbot/modules/internal/unarchive.py:93-123 (_check_archive_safe); the advisory's stated Zip-Slip mechanism could not be tied to any changed line, since the unarchive hunk is a post-extraction size cap and the other hunk is the preload-cache unpickler. Hidden-test scope may differ from the summary.
